Chapter 333: Chapter 2 Fifty Years Later (Please Subscribe) _2

Like a reckless bull.

Lin Yuan had waited until now to make a move because he hadn’t been confident before.

He was afraid that taking action would startle the Earthrock Mouse group and cause most of them to escape.

Over three hundred Earthrock Mice, so much flesh and soul, even without counting the Earthrock Mouse King, could greatly enhance Lin Yuan’s strength.

Not to mention…

“The Earthrock Mouse King built its nest here because of a strain of Earth Element Elixir?”

...

Lin Yuan carefully sensed and discovered an extremely pure Earth Element spiritual power diffusing and spreading deep within a hundred meters underground in the Rat Dynasty.

Lin Yuan guessed that the reason the Earthrock Mouse King could grow to a two-meter size was closely related to that strain of Earth Element Elixir.

“Mine.”

“All mine.”

Lin Yuan’s eyes burned with fervor, and with a slight shift in his thoughts, hundreds of branches, as well as roots, began to approach the Rat Dynasty’s location.

…

Dozens of meters underground.

Several ‘tunnels’ ran in all directions, and gray Earthrock Mice half a meter in size constantly moved back and forth along the ‘tunnels,’ bringing all the food they could find back to the Rat King.

Suddenly.

At that moment.

An Earthrock Mouse suddenly stopped.

It gently sniffed the air with its nose, sensing something.

The next moment.

Before this Earthrock Mouse could react.

A black branch, as tough as refined iron, pierced through it.

“Squeak…”

The Earthrock Mouse let out a miserable squeak, and soon, its flesh and soul were completely devoured by the branch.

Next.

It was the doom of the Earthrock Mice.

One after another, black branches continuously pierced through Earthrock Mice, devouring their essence and souls, transforming it into their intrinsic strength in a virtuous cycle.

“Awesome!”

On the surface, Lin Yuan felt extremely fulfilled, a massive amount of Earthrock Mice’s essence and souls transforming into surging power, replenishing his own.

If it were just a normal Demon Tree Seed, it couldn’t possibly devour so many Earthrock Mice at once.

It would have exploded.

But Lin Yuan was different, as a Seventh Rank Evolver, he could rapidly absorb all the power under his control of the realm.

“Foreign Evil God, there is some trick to it…”

As Lin Yuan devoured the Earthrock Mice, he thought to himself.

The devouring ability he displayed at this moment stemmed from the innate instinct of the Demon Tree Seed, which was the power of the Ancestral Demon Tree.

This ability had almost no side effects, you see, even in the Main World’s devour type Evolution Path, consuming flesh and soul would impact the purity of one’s own soul.

But the devouring power of the Demon Tree was extremely dominant, be it flesh or soul, both were nutrients for itself.

“Unfortunately, once it reaches the Seventh and Eighth Layer, what matters is the comprehension of rules, and the accumulation of energy is actually not that important.”

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly.

The ‘Scarlet Spirit Liquid’ from the Red Kun Lineage is the best example.

The power of the Demon Tree Seed has an almost cheat-like effect below the Seventh Rank but becomes much weaker once reaching the Seventh Rank.

“Hmm?”

“We’re getting close to that Rat King’s Underground Palace…”

Lin Yuan’s expression became slightly serious.

…

A hundred meters underground.

A small palace spanned across.

This palace, constructed entirely of dirt, though lacking in details, was considered a very fine structure for rats.

However.

Hiss.

A black branch swept lightly like a black dragon, crushing a tenth of the palace.

“Squeak squeak—”

A two-meter large Earthrock Mouse King sprang out, looking at the collapsing palace with a glimmer of anger in its eyes.

As a Second Layer Demonic Beast, the Earthrock Mouse King had developed some intelligence, otherwise, it wouldn’t have specifically built a palace to reside in.

Seeing the palace destroyed, it naturally felt emotional turmoil.

However, just as the Earthrock Mouse King was observing the black branch resembling a black dragon and considering how to attack it.

Boom boom boom.

Several more black branches swept over once again.

Startled, the Earthrock Mouse King quickly retreated.

“Squeak squeak.”

The Earthrock Mouse King hurriedly squealed a few times.

It signaled other Earthrock Mice to come and protect it.

However, no matter how the Earthrock Mouse King called,

only a few Earthrock Mice came.

And they had just arrived when they were pierced by the black branches and rapidly turned to dust.

“Run.”

Although the Earthrock Mouse King had Second Layer strength,

seeing this scene, where would it dare stay any longer.

He instinctively wanted to run.

In the depths of the palace, there was a tunnel personally dug by the Earthrock Mouse King.

Connected to another place, as long as he emerged from that tunnel, the Earthrock Mouse King had the possibility to escape to freedom.

Shh.

Before the Earthrock Mouse King could run far,

he was surrounded by black branches that rushed over.

The Earthrock Mouse King instinctively activated his life-saving measures.

A dull yellow light rose from his body.

But facing the continuous attack of hundreds of black branches,

the dull yellow light on the Earthrock Mouse King’s body eventually shattered, and the two-meter-sized Earthrock Mouse King became nourishment for Lin Yuan’s growth.

…

“Mmm…”

“This is comfortable…”

Lin Yuan exhaled softly, the branches swaying slightly.

The Second Layer Earthrock Mouse King was definitely the most delicious life that Lin Yuan had devoured since his arrival.

The ample blood energy and fearful soul brought pleasure to both Lin Yuan’s body and mind.

“That’s about it.”

“Let’s see what that Earth Element Elixir is?”

Lin Yuan’s controlled black branches cleared the underground battlefield and eventually reached the deepest part of the Underground Palace where the Earthrock Mouse King resided.

There, a palm-sized spiritual plant was growing.

Under the leaves of the spiritual plant hang several spirit fruits the size of a little finger, with faint vibrations of earth element spiritual power emanating from them.

“Is this the Earth Element Elixir that could catalyze a Second Layer Rat King?”

Lin Yuan inspected it carefully; he did not recognize what this spiritual medicine was.

But it didn’t matter, as he was going to directly swallow it anyway; there was no difference.

Lin Yuan was just curious about what the mystery was behind such a small spiritual medicine.

“Let’s eat it.”

Without hesitation, Lin Yuan’s black branches swept in, directly devouring all the spiritual power and essence of that spiritual medicine.

“Done.”

“Everything is finished.”

“We can leave now.”

After devouring the Earthrock Mouse horde and that spiritual medicine,

Lin Yuan was fully satisfied and began to control the roots, slowly moving towards the depths of the Yunwu Mountain Range.

Although the Demon Tree could move on its own and was not confined to a specific location, its speed was not very fast.

To avoid being noticed by other demonic beasts, Lin Yuan moved whenever there were no other demonic beasts passing nearby.

Half a month later,

Lin Yuan successfully entered deep into the Yunwu Mountain Range.

This area was already the outer layer deep within the mountain range, with abundant spiritual power, and the number of demonic beasts also increased.

Flutter.

As Lin Yuan’s branches swayed, he devoured hundreds of Earthrock Mice, including the Earthrock Mouse King and the Earth Element Elixir.

Lin Yuan’s body size soared to over ten meters.

The pitch-black main trunk and leaves emitted a chilling essence.

As the offspring of the Demon Tree, Lin Yuan was naturally aligned with the ‘evil’ faction.

“This won’t do.”

“I need to disguise my aura.”

Lin Yuan thought, if he continued to exude an evil aura, he could forget about hunting; which demonic beast would dare to approach?

“It shouldn’t be difficult to develop a secret technique to conceal and disguise one’s aura.”

Lin Yuan began to comprehend again, creating a breath-hiding secret technique based on the characteristics of the Demon Tree itself.

[Your perception defies the heavens, you feel your own aura circulating, attempting to create a breath-hiding secret technique…]

…

[Your perception defies the heavens, you feel your own aura circulating, attempting to create a breath-hiding secret technique…]

…

[Your perception defies the heavens, you feel your own aura circulating, attempting to create a breath-hiding secret technique…]

…

Several days later,

Lin Yuan successfully developed a breath-hiding secret technique.

Upon activation, his evil aura began to converge.

Instead, it emitted a harmless aura.

Under these circumstances, some passing birds unwittingly stopped to rest on Lin Yuan’s branches.

“Not bad, not bad.”

Lin Yuan had no interest in those frail birds; these birds hardly had any life force, and he was too lazy to even bother devouring them.

“That wolf demon over there?”

Lin Yuan’s perception spread out and discovered several miles away, there was a den of wolves.

The leader of the wolves was seven to eight meters in size, resembling a small hill.

…

Just like that,

time rapidly passed by.

In the blink of an eye, fifty years had passed since Lin Yuan arrived in this world.
